content: Kodwomnda yi tuf
Tǝthlǝnda Faara yi tuf pii yighǝn kodwomnda nǝn. Na wufǝlngaara ni mukɗa hai a fǝrakh amshi hu ƙǝshiirha hai, fǝrang ngganda ǝn cha kwaminda na inang kwaminda kwadɗa ɗǝ na kuɗimnggǝn kaan.
Inangga wufǝlngarɗi mii kwadɗa ɗǝ na kuɗimnggǝn kaan, tǝrgha kyagha ine sǝ ƙǝla ini henggel ɓǝrha. Yanfara tǝ ɓereurha wulangga iniɗi kanda.
Kyagha mbeeya ɓa hu iniɗi, tǝra nda hu ƙǝshiirha hai, fǝrang sǝsǝmnda chaarha nda kanda ƙǝla yi ngǝrɗaya.
Ndangganda kanda a ǝnang nda ˈya hwaliiya fa na a hweeɗe wa, nduwa ɗǝfrha ni, nduwa kala ˈya kyagha sǝ, ƙǝl nafini kee mbuwa tǝ ɗǝf haar Faara fa hu pǝm ndan.
Nggǝmang ngwanda kanda fa a ɓǝlang ngganda nafiniya wa, ƙǝl a sǝsang ngganda kanda kee yi ndǝre tuf. Hatta sǝsadɗiya nǝghǝn ƙǝla hatta chad ngǝrɗarha.
Hu ɓengginiya na fiya kaɗa mǝrra ka a mǝra nda, amma mba nda a walghǝn wa, na mǝrra kukwasang kanda fa, amma na mǝrra ɗarha ma kanda.
Mbeeyini ya na nda ƙǝla pǝrsaya ngwang nanda kanda fa ka yanda, na ǝngya sǝ a tendan ƙǝla tǝtar tǝfasa, yindan ƙǝla yi nafiya.
Was yi ndan ƙǝla yi ten nishya, thlan nggindan ƙǝla thlan lǝfari.
Ƙǝnang nda ƙǝfan ndan tǝ ˈya na ƙǝla ɗǝɓǝla, pakhki ndan a riirha ƙǝla pǝrsaya natǝ keke yanda na a ɗaarha ka yanda ɗǝ.
Na nda tǝ ndusa fa yi chaarha ƙǝla ngǝrɗarha, na nda tǝ sǝsǝmnda na a sǝsangganda fiya yi ndǝre tuf tǝ ndus ndan.

Na nda tǝ kutǝra na a ǝna kutǝryirha aten ndan, ndǝghǝnni tǝthlǝnda Faara fǝrang nanda sǝsǝmnda aten kwadɗi na kuɗimnggǝn. Thlǝmnggǝn tǝ mii Ibraniyaya, “Abaddon.” Tǝ mii Helenaya ƙǝm, “Afolliyon” ndaarha ni, “tǝ sǝɓang ˈya ɗǝ”.
Kawa ɓillarha nanǝnya mbǝrɗa ɗǝ, amma takh fingya sǝsaaya sǝri ɓayi.
Kodwomnda yi mikki
Tǝrgha tǝthlǝnda Faara yi mikki pii yighǝn kodwomnda nǝn. Sǝk urad ˈya ni na a kyarha ɓa hu kudma faɗa a mbǝd nji sataka yi tǝfasa na a mbed Faara.
Ndangga uradɗi tǝthlǝnda Faara yi mikki, “Kalu fathlǝngya Faara hai faɗa ƙǝnang nanda kanda hai hu Kufad Yufǝretus na manggǝn!”
Kal fathlǝngya Faara nda hai na faɗa, kanda ni ngwang nanda kanda fa ƙǝsǝr ka sayidɗi, tǝ yi farɗi, tǝ yi ndǝriɗi, tǝƙǝm yi huradɗi ƙǝsǝr ka a ɓǝlangganda tal hu mahan niifa tǝ wasa in heu.
Sǝk hangnda sodjaya ni na tǝr pǝrsaya sǝlgha kumnggitghǝn kum katǝra kumnggitghǝn kum.

Ahu ˈya nani, naɗi pǝrsaya tǝ nafiya na a tǝr kanda, kal nda ƙǝsǝmnda a ƙǝfayi nda yi ɗǝɓǝla yiɓa ƙǝla waarha, wulerǝn ƙǝla fǝrakh amshi, shimarǝn ƙǝla wad henggel ɓǝrha. Ten pǝrsa yini na nda ƙǝla ten lǝfari, waarha tǝ ine na ƙǝla wad henggel ɓǝrha ndǝna a kyarha ɓa hu mii ndan.
Patal yini mahan ya nda waarha, tǝ ine na ƙǝla wad henggel ɓǝrha a kyarha ɓa hu mii pǝrsa yini ndǝn ɓǝlangga fiya ɗǝ heu tal hu mahan.
Ƙǝsǝr ƙǝsǝmnda pǝrsa yini ya nǝghǝn hu mii ndan tǝ ndus ndan. Ndus ndan nǝghǝn ƙǝla huthlingya na tǝ teena fa, ndǝna ǝnang wundǝrha fiya fa.

Tahad nafiya natǝ wasa in ɓǝlang ngwa nanda kanda tǝ patal ɗiya, kwa wanda pǝma na a malang ngganda ǝnggini ǝna nanda tǝ har ndan wa. Malang ngwa nda fǝrang mamnggirha ǝnkaheeya, tǝ ɗahaya ǝna nanda tǝ tǝfasa, tǝ wurirha, tǝ tǝɓǝla, tǝ feera, tǝ ɗǝfrha wa. Ɗahaya ǝngya mbuwa na mana hai, nduwa sǝk ˈya nda, nduwa wii nda hai wa.
Kwa wanda pǝma hu ɓǝl farha na nda a ǝnaarha, nduwa thrǝfkid ndan, nduwa kulafayid ndan, nduwa ngaara na ndan a ǝnaarha wa.
